PLAN "Vegan Hypertrophy 12-Week"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build muscle and strength with plant-based support"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation Hypertrophy" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower 1: Squat Focus":
        warmup:
          rower 5m
        main straight_sets:
          Back Squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          Romanian Deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Walking Dumbbell Lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Leg Press 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Seated Leg Curl 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Standing Calf Raise 4x10..15 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          Treadmill Walk 5m
      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Upper 1: Push Emphasis":
        warmup:
          air_bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          Barbell Bench Press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Incline Dumbbell Press 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Cable Fly 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          Lateral Raise 4x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          Rope Triceps Pressdown 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds

          Elliptical 5m
